verdict.rationale: Pilot is a managed accounting service with a client portal, so user-scheduled recurring workflows are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no user-facing scheduler or recurring job capability. "Custom workflows and reporting" is a pricing-tier line item with no mention of user-configurable recurring schedules, and the monthly close is a service performed by Pilot's staff rather than a feature users can schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
